core_obligations: Collect the geometric inputs (proof lines 18528-18532): a finite morphism is proper, and the base change of a finite morphism is finite.

Apply the criterion (proof lines 18533-18536): hence the base change property follows from the injective-sheaf form of base change combined with the vanishing of the higher direct images of a finite morphism.
proof_roadmap: Recall that finiteness is preserved by base change and implies properness.
Combine the injective form of the base change criterion with the vanishing of the higher direct images.
difficulty_reason: The lemma records that cohomology commutes with base change for finite morphisms (statement lines 18518-18525). The proof (proof lines 18527-18536) uses that finite morphisms are proper with finite base changes, and combines the injective form of base change with the vanishing of the higher direct images of a finite morphism. H2: two inputs plus one criterion. The statement carries the author's slogan environment, delivered verbatim.
